verdict.rationale: Typesense publishes a first-party MCP server doc page (typesense-docs-43). It states that an AI agent can connect to Typesense Cloud and, from the conversation, create and configure clusters, build collections, index data, tune search and read metrics. This is reinforced by the docs' 'Typesense for AI Agents' section and an llms.txt that positions the product for AI agents. missing for 10: setup and auth/transport details for the MCP server, any evidence that it works with self-hosted (non-Cloud) Typesense, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
